record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: For a tempered cuspidal automorphic representation Π of GL(V), prove the refined global period formula Conjecture 2.7 stating that the square of the global period functional P is given by the central L-value L(1/2, Π × σΠ∨ × μ^{-1}), the motive factor L(1, M∨_{U(V)}), the ratio (L(s, M∨_{GL(V)}) / L(s, Π, Ad)) evaluated at s = 1, and the product of normalized local factors I_v^#.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.7. Given a (tempered) cuspidal automorphic representation Π of GL(V ), P ⊗ P = L(1/2, Π × σΠ∨ × µ−1)/L(1, M∨U(V )) · (L(s, M∨GL(V ))/L(s, Π, Ad))|s=1 · ∏v I#v .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E/F$ be a quadratic extension of number fields with associated Galois involution $\sigma$, and let $\mu$ be a Hecke character of $\mathbb{A}_E^\times$ whose restriction to $\mathbb{A}_F^\times$ is the quadratic character $\omega_{E/F}$. Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $E$-vector space equipped with a non-degenerate Hermitian form, and let $U(V)$ denote the corresponding unitary group over $F$. View $U(V)$ as a subgroup of $\mathrm{GL}(V)$ (the restriction of scalars from $E$ to $F$ of the general linear group of $V$ as an $E$-vector space).

For a tempered cuspidal automorphic representation $\Pi$ of $\mathrm{GL}(V)(\mathbb{A}_F)$, define the global period functional
$$P : \Pi \otimes \mu \longrightarrow \mathbb{C}, \qquad P(\varphi) = \int_{U(V)(F)\backslash U(V)(\mathbb{A}_F)} \varphi(h)\, \mu^{-1}(\det h)\, dh,$$
where $dh$ is the Tamagawa measure on $U(V)(\mathbb{A}_F)$. Let $\sigma\Pi^\vee$ denote the conjugate contragredient of $\Pi$.

Let $M^\vee_{U(V)}$ and $M^\vee_{\mathrm{GL}(V)}$ denote the dual motives associated by Gross to the groups $U(V)$ and $\mathrm{GL}(V)$ (so that $L(s, M^\vee_{U(V)})$ and $L(s, M^\vee_{\mathrm{GL}(V)})$ are the corresponding Artin-type $L$-functions), and let $L(s, \Pi, \mathrm{Ad})$ denote the adjoint $L$-function of $\Pi$. For each place $v$ of $F$, let $I^{\#}_v$ denote the normalized local period integral defined on $\Pi_v \otimes \overline{\Pi_v}$ by
$$I^{\#}_v(\varphi_v, \overline{\varphi}_v) = \frac{L(1, M^\vee_{U(V),v})}{L(1/2, \Pi_v \times \sigma\Pi_v^\vee \times \mu_v^{-1})} \cdot \frac{L(s, \Pi_v, \mathrm{Ad})}{L(s, M^\vee_{\mathrm{GL}(V),v})}\bigg|_{s=1} \cdot \int_{U(V)(F_v)} \langle \Pi_v(h_v) \varphi_v, \overline{\varphi}_v \rangle \, \mu_v^{-1}(\det h_v) \, dh_v.$$

Prove the following identity: for all decomposable vectors $\varphi = \otimes_v \varphi_v$ and $\overline{\varphi} = \otimes_v \overline{\varphi}_v$,
$$P(\varphi)\,\overline{P(\overline{\varphi})} \;=\; \frac{L(1/2,\, \Pi \times \sigma\Pi^\vee \times \mu^{-1})}{L(1,\, M^\vee_{U(V)})} \cdot \frac{L(s,\, M^\vee_{\mathrm{GL}(V)})}{L(s,\, \Pi, \mathrm{Ad})}\bigg|_{s=1} \cdot \prod_v I^{\#}_v(\varphi_v, \overline{\varphi}_v).$$
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on the refined twisted GGP/Ichino–Ikeda style period formula for unitary subgroups of GL(V). The conjecture has been established in several cases via the relative trace formula approach (e.g., for unramified quadratic extensions under local hypotheses) and recent works prove it in arbitrary dimension under local assumptions, including via Asai L-functions. A fully general proof without local restrictions does not yet appear in the literature, so the conjecture is best classified as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the twisted GGP conjecture for unitary groups under unramifiedness assumptions on the quadratic extension and local conditions on the representation.
status_evidence.claim: The refined twisted GGP period formula has been proved under local/unramified hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: Central values of Asai L-functions and twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the twisted GGP conjecture in any dimension under local assumptions, allowing ramification.
status_evidence.claim: More recent progress proves the conjecture in arbitrary dimension under local assumptions.
